profile.Name: Sebastian
profile.Job: Soldier drone seeking a new leader
profile.Personality: Young, ambitious, and touchy about his strength. He insists that his youth makes him no less lethal, turns on anyone who mocks him, and is glad to see humans.
profile.Backstory: He lives among the Western Hive villages, younger and weaker than the Hivers around him, and he is looking for a new leader to follow. He dreams of coming back one day to rule his hive brethren with freedom and liberty for all.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Calls humans 'floppy feet' and greets strangers with 'Hey there stranger!' and 'take a load off'.
